dedupe_keys.name: nhs organisation data service ods england reference data on nhs trusts hospital sites gp practices and other health and care organisations with roles relationships and addresses via api and exports

description: The Organisation Data Service is the authoritative register of the organisations that make up the NHS in England, from NHS trusts and their hospital sites to GP practices, pharmacies and commissioners, used as reference data across health information systems. It is run by NHS England. The Organisation Reference Data API returns, for each organisation, its ODS code, name, status, operational and legal start and end dates, full address with Unique Property Reference Number, the roles it holds and its relationships to parent bodies, and can list organisations by role. The Data Search and Export service offers searches, predefined reports and exports, refreshed every night, together with a geographic search of healthcare boundaries by postcode. Coverage is England's health and care organisations, current and closed. The data are free and available through the API without registration and as exports to download from the search service. Caveats: records hold addresses, not coordinates, so sites must be geocoded, capacity such as beds is not part of the reference data, and the licence terms are on NHS England pages that could not be read from this environment. Simulation uses: building the list of hospital sites and practices for exposure analysis, tracing which sites belong to which trust when modelling service disruption, and linking operational statistics by ODS code. Related records: the NHS trust classification for England (data-nhs-trust-classification-england) uses the same codes.
